def solve(I,O=None,dbg=False):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape; bg=int(I[0,0])
    cs=comps2(I,bg)
    objs=[]
    for c,s in cs:
        if len(s)>1:
            rs=[r for r,_ in s]; cs_=[c for _,c in s]
            norm={(r-min(rs), c-min(cs_)) for r,c in s}
            objs.append({'color':c,'cells':sorted(norm),'h':max(r for r,_ in norm)+1,'w':max(c for _,c in norm)+1})
    noise=[]
    for c,p in cs:
        if len(p)==1: noise.append((c,next(iter(p))))
    # absorb each noise pixel into the nearest obj by min Manhattan dist (absorb position = that cell; recolor to obj color)
    newobjs=[{'color':o['color'],'cells':set(o['cells'])} for o in objs]
    # prefer absorption onto orthogonally-adjacent side; use nearest-dist tie -> pick first by distance then min row then min col
    for c,(r,q) in noise:
        cands=[]
        for i,o in enumerate(newobjs):
            d=min(abs(r-x)+abs(q-y) for x,y in o['cells'])
            cands.append((d,i))
        cands.sort()
        i=cands[0][1]
        newobjs[i]['cells'].add((r,q))
    O=out_grid={} if O is None else O
    return newobjs, bg

import numpy as np, json
def comps(g,bg=None):
    bg=g[0,0] if bg is None else bg
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r,c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=int(g[r,c]); st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cs=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cs.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and g[ny,nx]==col and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append({'color':col,'cells':cs})
    return out

def solve(n):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    OH,OW=O.shape; bg=int(I[0,0])
    bi=comps(I); bigs=[o for o in bi if len(o['cells'])>1]; sgls=[s for s in bi if len(s['cells'])==1]
    objs=[]
    for o in bigs:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in o['cells']); c0=min(p[1] for p in o['cells'])
        objs.append(dict(color=int(o['color']),base=frozenset((p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in o['cells']),
                          absorbed=set(),orig=(r0,c0)))
    for s in sgls:
        p=s['cells'][0]
        best=min(bigs,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in o['cells']))
        j=bigs.index(best)
        objs[j]['absorbed'].add((p[0]-objs[j]['orig'][0],p[1]-objs[j]['orig'][1]))
    comp=[]
    for j,o in enumerate(objs):
        tot=o['base']|o['absorbed']
        h=max(p[0] for p in tot)+1; w=max(p[1] for p in tot)+1
        comp.append(dict(color=o['color'],offs=tot,h=h,w=w,n=len(tot)))
    # greedy: place largest first; slide down then left until collision
    def score(rr,cc):
        sh=[(rr+a,cc+b) for a,b in o['offs']]
        if any(x not in target or O[x[0],x[1]]!=o['color'] for x in sh): return -1
        if any(x in used for x in sh): return -1
        # maximize bottom row, then minimize left col
        return (-sh[-1][0] if False else (-(max(y for y,_ in sh)), cc))
    sols=[]
    def bt(k,used,grid):
        if k==len(comp):
            if used==target: sols.append([list(row) for row in grid]); return
        o=comp[k]
        best=None
        res=[]
        for rr in range(OH-o['h']+1):
            for cc in range(OW-o['w']+1):
                sh=[(rr+a,cc+b) for a,b in o['offs']]
                if any(x not in target or O[x[0],x[1]]!=o['color'] or x in used for x in sh): continue
                score_= (-max(y for y,_ in sh), cc)
                if best is None or score_<best: best=score_; res=[(rr,cc)]
                elif score_==best: res.append((rr,cc))
        for rr,cc in res[:3]:  # limit branch count
            newg=[list(row) for row in grid]
            for y,x in [(rr+a,cc+b) for a,b in o['offs']]: newg[y][x]=o['color']
            bt(k+1,used|set((rr+a,cc+b) for a,b in o['offs']),newg)
    bt(0,set(),[[int(bg)]*OW for _ in range(OH)])
    return sols

    sols=solve(n); O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    m=sum(1 for g in sols if all(g[r][c]==O[r][c] for r in range(len(O)) for c in range(len(O[0]))))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
from collections import deque

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def comps(g,bg=None):
    bg=g[0,0] if bg is None else bg
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r,c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=int(g[r,c]); st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cs=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cs.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and g[ny,nx]==col and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append({'color':col,'cells':cs})
    return out

def solve(n):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    OH,OW=O.shape; bg=int(I[0,0])
    bi=comps(I); bigs=[o for o in bi if len(o['cells'])>1]; sgls=[s for s in bi if len(s['cells'])==1]
    objs=[]
    for o in bigs:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in o['cells']); c0=min(p[1] for p in o['cells'])
        objs.append(dict(color=int(o['color']),base=frozenset((p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in o['cells']),
                          absorbed=set(),orig=(r0,c0)))
    for s in sgls:
        p=s['cells'][0]
        best=min(bigs,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in o['cells']))
        j=bigs.index(best)
        objs[j]['absorbed'].add((p[0]-objs[j]['orig'][0],p[1]-objs[j]['orig'][1]))
    comp=[]
    for j,o in enumerate(objs):
        tot=o['base']|o['absorbed']
        h=max(p[0] for p in tot)+1; w=max(p[1] for p in tot)+1
        comp.append(dict(color=o['color'],offs=tot,h=h,w=w,n=len(tot)))
    target={(r,c) for r in range(OH) for c in range(OW) if O[r,c]!=bg}
    sols=[]
    def bt(k,used,grid):
        if k==len(comp):
            if used==target: sols.append([list(row) for row in grid]); return
        o=comp[k]
        for rr in range(OH-o['h']+1):
            for cc in range(OW-o['w']+1):
                sh=[(rr+a,cc+b) for a,b in o['offs']]
                if any(x not in target or O[x[0],x[1]]!=o['color'] for x in sh): continue
                if any(x in used for x in sh): continue
                newg=[list(row) for row in grid]
                for y,x in sh: newg[y][x]=o['color']
                bt(k+1,used|set(sh),newg)
    bt(0,set(),[[int(bg)]*OW for _ in range(OH)])
    return sols

ok_all=True
for n in range(1,9):
    sols=solve(n); O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    m=sum(1 for g in sols if all(g[r][c]==O[r][c] for r in range(len(O)) for c in range(len(O[0]))))
    ok_all&=m==len(sols)
    print(n,'nsol',len(sols),'exacts',m)
print('ALL EXACT' if ok_all else 'MISMATCH')
T=G['Test input']
P=solve(None) if False else None
# run solver logic directly on Test: absorb + pack
bi=comps(T); bigs=[o for o in bi if len(o['cells'])>1]; sgls=[s for s in bi if len(s['cells'])==1]
objs=[]
for o in bigs:
    r0=min(p[0] for p in o['cells']); c0=min(p[1] for p in o['cells'])
    objs.append(dict(color=int(o['color']),base=frozenset((p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in o['cells']),
                      absorbed=set(),orig=(r0,c0)))
for s in sgls:
    p=s['cells'][0]
    best=min(bigs,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in o['cells']))
    j=bigs.index(best)
    objs[j]['absorbed'].add((p[0]-objs[j]['orig'][0],p[1]-objs[j]['orig'][1]))
comp=[]
for j,o in enumerate(objs):
    tot=o['base']|o['absorbed']
    h=max(p[0] for p in tot)+1; w=max(p[1] for p in tot)+1
    comp.append(dict(color=o['color'],offs=tot,h=h,w=w,n=len(tot)))
OH,OW=T.shape
used=set(); grid=[[int(T[0,0])]*OW for _ in range(OH)]
def place(k,used,grid):
    if k==len(comp):
        if used=={(r,c) for r in range(OH) for c in range(OW) if T[r,c]!=T[0,0]}:
            pass
        return
    o=comp[k]
    for rr in range(OH-o['h']+1):
        for cc in range(OW-o['w']+1):

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
def attach_global(bigs, sgls):
    # cost matrix stray x host = min manhattan distance to any host cell
    m=len(sgls); k=len(bigs)
    C=[[min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in bigs[j]['cells']) for j in range(k)] for p in sgls]
    row,col_idx=linear_sum_assignment(np.array(C))
    res=[]
    for i,j in zip(row,col_idx):
        p=sgls[i]['cells'][0]; host=bigs[j]
        r0=min(q[0] for q in host['cells']); c0=min(q[1] for q in host['cells'])
        res.append((host,j,(p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0)))
    return res

def solve(n,verbose=False):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    OH,OW=O.shape; bg=int(I[0,0])
    bi=comps(I); bigs=[o for o in bi if len(o['cells'])>1]; sgls=[s for s in bi if len(o['cells'])==1]
    att=attach_global(bigs,sgls)
    objs=[{'color':b['color'],'base':frozenset((p[0]-min(q[0] for q in b['cells']),p[1]-min(q[1] for q in b['cells'])) for p in b['cells']),'hostid':i,'absorbed':set() for i,b in enumerate(bigs)}]
    for h,j,off in att:
        objs[j]['absorbed'].add(off)
    comps_=[]
    for o in objs:
        tot=o['base']|o['absorbed']
        comps_.append({'color':o['color'],'offs':tot,'h':max(p[0] for p in tot)+1,'w':max(p[1] for p in tot)+1})
    target={(r,c) for r in range(OH) for c in range(OW) if O[r,c]!=bg}
    sols=[]
    def bt(k,used,grid,pos):
        if k==len(comps_):
            if used==target: sols.append([list(r_) for r_ in grid]); return
        o=comps_[k]
        for rr in range(OH-o['h']+1):
            for cc in range(OW-o['w']+1):
                sh=[(rr+a,cc+b) for a,b in o['offs']]
                if any(not(0<=y<OH and 0<=x<OW) for y,x in sh) or any((y,x) in used for y,x in sh): continue
                newg=[list(r_) for r_ in grid]
                for y,x in sh: newg[y][x]=o['color']
                bt(k+1,used|set(sh),newg,pos+[(rr,cc)])
    bt(0,set(),[[int(bg)]*OW for _ in range(OH)],[])
    return sols

for n in range(1,9):
    sols=solve(n); O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    m=sum(1 for g in sols if all(g[r][c]==O[r][c] for r in range(len(O)) for c in range(len(O[0]))))
    print(n,'nsol',len(sols),'exacts',m)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
ci=comps(I)
objs=[b for b in ci if len(b['cells'])>1]; sgls=[s for s in ci if len(s['cells'])==1]
added={i:set() for i in range(len(objs))}
for s in sgls:
    sr,sc=s['cells'][0]; host=None
    for i,o in enumerate(objs):
        if any(abs(q[0]-sr)+abs(q[1]-sc)==1 for q in o['cells']): host=i;break
    if host is None: host=min(range(len(objs)), key=lambda i: min(abs(sr-q[0])+abs(sc-q[1]) for q in objs[i]['cells']))
    ho=objs[host]
    bboxr=min(q[0] for q in ho['cells']); bboxc=min(q[1] for q in ho['cells'])
    added[host].add((sr-bboxr,sc-bboxc))
newobjs=[]
for i,b in enumerate(objs):
    r0=min(q[0] for q in b['cells']); c0=min(q[1] for q in b['cells'])
    tot=set((q[0]-r0,q[1]-c0) for q in b['cells'])|added[i]
    h=max(r for r,c in tot)+1; w=max(c for r,c in tot)+1
    newobjs.append({'color':b['color'],'tot':tot,'h':h,'w':w})
# print info for inspection
print([(o['color'],len(o['tot']),o['h'],o['w']) for o in newobjs])
# actual out bboxes
co=comps(O)
for c in co:
    rs=[q[0] for q in c['cells']]; cs_=[q[1] for q in c['cells']]
    print('out color',c['color'],'bbox',(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs_),max(cs_)))
